components.name: Product participant
components.responsibility: Plan work, express candidate-review intent, and explicitly confirm an exact effect.
components.authority_role: Authenticated Product participant; Product Owner for policy-bound auto-approval.
components.multiplicity: One bound actor per confirmation; many actors may belong to a Product.
prohibited_authority: Cannot delegate silent promotion to the coding agent
Cannot treat solver output as accepted Product truth

components.name: Released coding host and managed hook
components.responsibility: Emit the successful post-Planning boundary with exact host session and governing-spec binding.
components.process_boundary: Released Codex or Claude host process plus normally installed managed hook.
components.repository_runtime: External coding host with Bicameral managed installation.
components.multiplicity: One or more independent host sessions per Product.
prohibited_authority: Cannot substitute Plan prose for an absent spec binding

components.name: Packaged Managed MCP
components.responsibility: Relay typed requests and implement MCPDisplayContractV1 as synchronized human and structured candidate projections.
components.multiplicity: One MCP process per host installation or configured host session.

components.name: Product daemon
components.responsibility: Validate source and session identity, orchestrate extraction and SMR, own CandidateSet, authorize exact transitions, and construct canonical writes.
components.authority_role: Product runtime validator and sole canonical-command constructor.
components.multiplicity: One selected daemon per Product route; many Product routes may exist.
prohibited_authority: Cannot treat CandidateSet or SQLite as canonical
Cannot return stale or empty Product model as success

components.name: ClaimTrace extractor
components.responsibility: Produce a closed-schema source-bound advisory ClaimSemanticTraceV1.
components.process_boundary: Caller or local reasoning-provider boundary brokered by daemon.
components.multiplicity: One bounded attempt per exact analysis identity.

components.name: Deterministic SMR and Alloy kernel
components.responsibility: Validate and lower ClaimTrace, execute bounded checks, and return source-mapped findings and explicit refusals.
components.process_boundary: Merged bicameral-smr crate and pinned Alloy process boundary.
components.authority_role: Deterministic bounded analyzer without governance authority.
components.multiplicity: One kernel invocation per analysis identity; pinned solver child process as required.
prohibited_authority: Cannot claim global safety or completeness

components.name: Daemon session CandidateSet store
components.responsibility: Retain session-scoped CandidateSet, lease, previews, and transient dispositions across turns and bounded reconnects.
components.multiplicity: Logically isolated by Product and host session.

components.name: Canonical Product event store
components.responsibility: Atomically append exact accepted promotion and policy-bound approval effects and preserve replayable Product history.
components.process_boundary: Selected EventStoreAdapter and canonical Product event substrate.
components.authority_role: Sole Product-state commit point after daemon authorization.
components.multiplicity: One selected event stream per Product routing identity.
prohibited_authority: Cannot partially append one confirmed selection

components.name: Decision and SMR replay projection
components.responsibility: Catch up canonical history and rebuild current Decisions, accepted Claims, and RecallPacket inputs.
components.multiplicity: One caught-up projection per Product store route.
prohibited_authority: Cannot return stale or empty state as current

relationships.interaction: Host-fired post-Planning managed hook submits exact session, Plan digest, and governing spec binding.
relationships.medium: Host lifecycle hook to packaged MCP.
relationships.handoff: Synchronous invocation with typed timeout outcome.
authority_boundaries: Released external host to Bicameral Tool Surface
Trigger does not grant Product authority

relationships.interaction: Relay versioned preflight, selection, confirmation, heartbeat, and session-end requests.
relationships.medium: ToolRequest/ToolResult over configured local daemon transport.
relationships.handoff: Synchronous typed request with idempotent operation identities where state may change.
authority_boundaries: MCP process to daemon authority boundary
No caller-supplied canonical routing

relationships.interaction: Provide bounded exact spec and accepted context for one extraction attempt.
relationships.handoff: Bounded request canceled at policy timeout.
authority_boundaries: Daemon-controlled context to untrusted probabilistic provider

relationships.interaction: Return untrusted source-bound ClaimTrace and limitations.
authority_boundaries: Probabilistic output to deterministic daemon validation

relationships.interaction: Submit validated ClaimTrace and exact accepted-model snapshot for deterministic bounded analysis.
relationships.medium: In-process Rust API plus pinned Alloy child process.
relationships.handoff: Fail-closed validation and bounded analyzer receipt.
authority_boundaries: Proposal analysis cannot cross canonical Product boundary

relationships.interaction: Create, read, heartbeat, reconcile, and erase session CandidateSet state.
relationships.handoff: Durable across daemon restart only while session lease is valid.
authority_boundaries: Operational persistence remains noncanonical and session-isolated

relationships.interaction: Return exact spec annotations, structured candidates, previews, receipts, and refreshed recall.
relationships.medium: ToolResult human content plus structured content.
relationships.handoff: One synchronized semantic result rendered under MCPDisplayContractV1.
authority_boundaries: Daemon-authored meaning to presentation-only MCP surface

relationships.interaction: Express natural-language candidate selection and explicit exact-effect confirmation.
relationships.handoff: Human gesture interpreted by agent, then validated by daemon against stable identities.
authority_boundaries: Human intent to automated Tool Surface
Agent mediation never becomes authority

relationships.interaction: Atomically compare and append selected promotion and policy-bound approval events.
relationships.handoff: All selected events commit or none; same operation recovers prior result.
authority_boundaries: Daemon authorization to sole canonical Product commit point

relationships.interaction: Replay canonical events and catch projection up before successful recall.
relationships.handoff: Deterministic ordered replay with fail-closed predecessor validation.
authority_boundaries: Canonical Product state to noncanonical read model

states.artifact: Exact governing specification revision and ManagedPlanningBoundaryV1
states.persistence_location: Content-addressed local source evidence bound to exact repository, head, path, blob, and digest.
states.routing_key: product_id plus governing_spec_binding_digest plus host_session_id and host_turn_id
states.mutation_path: New immutable capture for a new exact binding; existing bytes are never rewritten.
states.lifecycle: Retained as source evidence when promoted content requires provenance; otherwise bounded local retention.

states.routing_key: exact analysis identity and trace digest
states.mutation_path: Extractor proposes; daemon validates or refuses; valid traces are immutable.
states.lifecycle: Rebuildable advisory artifact for the active session CandidateSet generation.
prohibited_fallbacks: Use raw prose as deterministic analyzer input

states.persistence_location: Daemon session analysis cache with exact input and model digests.
states.routing_key: ClaimTrace digest plus accepted-model snapshot and analyzer profile
states.mutation_path: Recomputed for changed exact inputs; never patched by MCP.
states.lifecycle: Session-bounded advisory result with explicit unknown/refusal scope.

states.artifact: CandidateSetV1 with pending, promoted, and transiently rejected DecisionCandidates
states.persistence_location: Daemon-local session store, optionally SQLite, isolated from canonical Product history.
states.routing_key: product_id plus host_session_id plus candidate_set_generation and session_lease_id
states.mutation_path: Daemon-only create/reuse, confirmed transient reject, post-append promote reconciliation, and lease cleanup.
states.lifecycle: Available for the active coding session; erased on explicit end or after 300-second reconnect grace expiry.

states.persistence_location: Short-lived daemon session scratch bound to actor, session, selection, policy, spec, and base.
states.routing_key: candidate_set_generation plus selection_digest plus actor and challenge identity
states.mutation_path: Prepared read-only; consumed once by exact explicit confirmation; invalidated by drift or restart policy.
states.lifecycle: Single-use and shorter-lived than CandidateSet; erased on consumption, invalidation, or session cleanup.

states.artifact: Managed preflight timeout and Product-owner auto-approve-on-promotion policy
states.persistence_location: Selected canonical Product policy substrate and replayed policy projection.
states.mutation_path: Governed Product policy command outside this candidate session; read and revalidated at promotion.
states.lifecycle: Versioned canonical policy; alpha timeout default 60 seconds and reconnect grace default 300 seconds.
prohibited_fallbacks: Unversioned environment variable treated as authority

states.artifact: Accepted candidate promotion and optional owner-policy approval event batch
states.persistence_location: Canonical Product event log through selected EventStoreAdapter.
states.mutation_path: Daemon-authorized atomic compare-and-append of all selected candidate events or none.
states.lifecycle: Immutable and replayable; same operation returns prior result.

states.artifact: Promoted Decision with proposed or policy-approved signoff
states.persistence_location: Decision Ledger materialized by canonical event replay.
states.mutation_path: Only replay of authorized accepted events.
states.lifecycle: Durable Product history; existing proposed, approved, rejected, and superseded semantics apply.
prohibited_fallbacks: Visible intermediate proposed state for atomic auto-approve

states.artifact: Daemon-authored RecallPacket and managed preflight result
states.routing_key: product_id plus canonical projection position plus active session CandidateSet generation
states.mutation_path: Rebuilt after canonical catch-up and joined with session candidates without merging authority classes.
states.lifecycle: Advisory response; refreshed after confirmed disposition or canonical change.
prohibited_fallbacks: Stale or empty accepted model as success

transitions.trigger: Successful post-Planning hook with exact governing spec binding.
transitions.persistence_effect: Create validated session analysis artifact or typed limitation; no canonical write.

transitions.trigger: Validated ClaimTrace and bounded SMR analysis complete.
transitions.persistence_effect: Create or reuse one daemon-local CandidateSet generation for the exact session analysis identity.

transitions.trigger: User natural-language intent resolved by agent to structured candidate identities.
transitions.persistence_effect: Create a short-lived exact preview/challenge only after dependency and currentness validation; no Candidate or Product disposition.

transitions.trigger: Explicit human confirmation of exact transient rejection effects.
transitions.persistence_effect: Mark selected candidates rejected in session state only; append no canonical event or tombstone.

transitions.trigger: Explicit human confirmation of a current dependency-closed promotion selection.
transitions.persistence_effect: Atomically append one distinct promotion event per selected candidate or append none.
Materialize deterministic proposed or policy-approved Decisions from canonical history.

transitions.trigger: Projection reaches canonical head after promotion or a read-only preflight request completes.
transitions.persistence_effect: Produce a recomputable RecallPacket that keeps accepted, proposed, evidence, contradictions, limitations, and receipts distinct.

transitions.trigger: Explicit host session end or session lease expiry after 300-second reconnect grace.
transitions.persistence_effect: Erase pending and rejected candidates, previews, and challenges; retain canonical Decisions and receipts under their own retention policy.

scenarios.name: Post-Planning exact-spec preflight
scenarios.trigger: Released host completes Planning and fires the managed hook.
authority_boundaries: Host trigger is evidence only
Extractor and solver remain advisory
CandidateSet remains session-local
scenarios.expected_result: Exact annotated spec plus synchronized structured candidates, no-candidate, or typed limitation without prohibiting work.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Missing/ambiguous spec, invalid trace, solver refusal, or timeout returns typed limitation and no fabricated reassurance.

scenarios.name: MCP text-and-structured journey display
scenarios.trigger: Managed MCP receives daemon-authored preflight, preview, receipt, or typed recovery result.
authority_boundaries: Display state is not Product state
Color and position never grant authority
Agent mediation never replaces explicit human confirmation
scenarios.expected_result: MCPDisplayContractV1 exposes exact human content and synchronized structured content, accessible labels, allowed next operations, and typed recovery for current renderer state.
scenarios.failure_behavior: A human/structured mismatch returns presentation_contract_error; renderer must not guess, rewrite the specification, hide recovery, or strengthen evidence authority.

scenarios.name: Advisory 60-second timeout
scenarios.trigger: Managed analysis reaches current Product timeout policy.
authority_boundaries: Operational deadline cannot become governance or work authority
scenarios.expected_result: analysis_timed_out with searched scope and limitations; coding session continues.
scenarios.failure_behavior: The daemon cancels the attempt and never maps timeout to no_candidate, no_conflict, safe, approved, ready, or released.

scenarios.name: Agent-mediated natural-language selection
scenarios.trigger: User describes candidates to promote or reject.
authority_boundaries: Agent resolves intent but daemon validates stable identities and closure
Prepare is read-only
scenarios.expected_result: Exact preview of promoted, rejected, and remaining pending candidates with bound signoff effect.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Unknown, stale, overlapping, or dependency-incomplete selection returns typed refusal and no preview challenge.

scenarios.name: Atomic selected candidate promotion
scenarios.trigger: User explicitly confirms a current promotion preview.
authority_boundaries: Human confirmation to daemon authorization
Canonical append is sole Product commit
Session reconciliation follows append
scenarios.expected_result: All selected candidates become distinct replayable Decisions or none; unmentioned candidates remain pending.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Any stale actor, policy, spec, base, selection, or proposal appends nothing; response-loss retry returns the existing result.

scenarios.name: Product-owner auto-approval on promotion
scenarios.trigger: Current Product Owner confirms Promote and approve under enabled current policy.
authority_boundaries: Only current Product Owner plus bound canonical policy may reach approved signoff
scenarios.expected_result: Atomic replay directly materializes approved Decisions with no observable intermediate proposed state.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Policy drift, owner revocation, agent-only request, or preview mismatch appends nothing and returns typed refusal.

scenarios.name: Explicit transient session rejection
scenarios.trigger: User explicitly confirms exact rejection effects for selected session candidates.
authority_boundaries: Explicit human disposition remains noncanonical and session-scoped
scenarios.expected_result: Selected candidates are visibly rejected for the session; no canonical rejection event or future suppression is created.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Stale or mismatched preview changes no state; session end erases the rejection with remaining transient candidates.

scenarios.name: Session reconnect and cleanup
scenarios.trigger: Host disconnects, reconnects, explicitly ends, or misses lease grace.
authority_boundaries: Only matching session and lease may resume
Cleanup cannot alter canonical Decisions
scenarios.expected_result: Matching reconnect within 300 seconds resumes; explicit end or expiry erases every unpromoted candidate and scratch challenge.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Different or expired session gets session_lease_expired and cannot enumerate prior candidates.

scenarios.name: Forbidden unattended agent promotion
scenarios.trigger: Coding agent calls commit without a valid human-bound exact preview confirmation or attempts to change policy.
authority_boundaries: Automated Tool Surface never acquires Product promotion or policy authority
scenarios.failure_behavior: No challenge minting, canonical append, Candidate disposition, or policy mutation occurs.

scenarios.name: Canonical append response loss and replay
scenarios.trigger: Promotion transaction commits but MCP does not receive the result.
authority_boundaries: Canonical history, not MCP receipt, determines commit result
scenarios.expected_result: Same bound operation returns prior canonical result and refreshed recall without a duplicate append.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Different binding under same operation returns conflict; new operation cannot dispose the same selected candidate generation twice.
